SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  cls,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_t >= 208 AND fish_date_t <= 274
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  cls,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_t > 274 AND fish_date_t <= 335
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC
